name: Demisette Cloyce
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Demisette Cloyce teaches warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. She guides students in fel magic and sends those ready for more toward other summoners.

sections.title: The Crypts of the Slaughtered Lamb
sections.body: Warlocks gather in the cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, while the city's authorities uphold order and the Holy Light. Demisette Cloyce lives in the catacombs below, teaching those willing to study forbidden arts. She warns that dark energies corrupt only those without the discipline to master them.

sections.title: Connecting the Covens
sections.body: Demisette guides warlocks beyond Stormwind when they have gained enough mastery. She connects them with summoners such as Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, where they can seek potent artifacts and learn to bind formidable fel steeds.

faq.answer: Demisette Cloyce trains warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. She teaches demonic summoning and dark spells.

faq.q: Why is she hiding in a tavern cellar?
aliases: why is she in the cellar
faq.answer: Warlocks gather in the cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, away from public view. Its cellar offers a discreet place for their dark practices.

faq.q: What is her connection to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Demisette sends experienced warlocks across the sea to Menara Voidrender in Ratchet, on the coast of the Barrens. They seek advanced rituals, powerful orbs, and binding rites.

faq.q: How does she react to non-warlocks?
faq.answer: Demisette has contempt for outsiders. Unless you follow the path of a warlock, she warns that darkness does not embrace you and orders you to stop talking and leave.

angles.text: As a warlock in Stormwind, you can learn fundamental spellcraft from Demisette. She later points you toward claiming a felsteed and binding demonic orbs.
As a human, you can find Demisette beneath Stormwind, where she has turned from the Holy Light to demonic power.
